definitions: Sir Henry Parkes (1815-1896), a British-Australian statesman who was the Premier of New South Wales five times.
Parkes Observatory, a radio telescope observatory near Parkes, New South Wales, Australia.
Parkes, a town in New South Wales, Australia.
examples: The Parkes family reunion is next month.
Sir Henry Parkes was a key figure in Australian federation.
The Parkes Observatory made significant discoveries.
We drove through Parkes on our way to Sydney.
